Contact and Corrections

Contact the site owner about feedback, factual errors, rights, or business matters.

Contact the publication

Seahawks Fan Zone is individually operated. Email the site owner at laura@caferacerstudios.com.

There is no web contact form or automated ticket system. Please send inquiries directly by email.

Corrections

For a possible factual or data error, use the subject “Correction” and include the page URL, the statement or value at issue, and a reliable supporting source. The site owner will review the request and correct confirmed errors. Material article changes receive an updated date.

Rights and copyright concerns

Use the subject “Rights request” and identify the specific text, image, logo, or other material, its page URL, and the basis for your request. Include a way to verify that you are the rights holder or are authorized to act for one.

Advertising and business inquiries

Use the subject “Business inquiry” and describe the organization and proposal. Sending an inquiry does not guarantee placement or coverage. Advertising and affiliate relationships do not determine editorial conclusions.
